name: Unload idle Ollama models to free GPU memory, with a dry-run log first

parameters.content:
## Ollama GPU guard

For people who share one GPU between local LLMs and other apps. Every 10 minutes this asks Ollama which models are loaded and unloads the ones that have sat idle too long, so the VRAM comes back. It ships in dry-run mode: it only logs what it would unload.

### How it works
1. GET /api/ps on your Ollama server.
2. Ollama sets expires_at to last use plus keep_alive. The guard estimates last use as expires_at minus assumedKeepAliveMinutes and calls a model idle after idleMinutes.
3. A model whose expires_at is more than 24 hours away counts as pinned and is skipped unless unloadPinned is true.
4. One log line is appended only when a model's state changes.
5. With dryRun false, each idle model gets one POST to /api/generate with keep_alive: 0.

### Setup steps
1. Self-hosted n8n that can reach Ollama. In Docker use http://host.docker.internal:11434.
2. Create the log folder from logPath in **Settings**. The default assumes the Docker ~/.n8n-files folder.
3. Run it once by hand and read the log.
4. Activate it. Set dryRun to false only when the log looks right.

### Customization
Match assumedKeepAliveMinutes to your OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE. Change the interval on the schedule trigger.

## Triggers and settings
Run once by hand or every 10 minutes. All knobs live in Settings. dryRun ships true.

## Read Ollama and decide
Lists loaded models, then marks each one keep, pinned, would unload, or unload.

## Log changes only
Remembers the last state per model and appends a line only when it changes.

## Live unload
Only runs when dryRun is false. Sends keep_alive 0 for each idle model.
